assumptions: 140 mm cube and all thicknesses are plausible estimates, not measured manufacturer dimensions.
Front is -Y, rear is +Y, left is -X; Z is up; meshes are in meters with unit scale 1.

Side references imply low-front/high-rear seam endpoints. Rear reference panels contradict this by repeating a low front seam. Use a continuous sloped seam with a high horizontal rear edge; rear fidelity requires user review.
The base is shallow at front and wedge-shaped toward rear. The tall front lid becomes shallow at rear. A uniformly shallow base cannot meet the diagonal sides without extra unsupported joints.
The visible reveal is the exterior of a separate fitted interior collar; no floating decorative strip, hidden hinges, magnets, or latches.
The removable lid lifts vertically before moving aside; it is not hinged.
Bottom wrap fold lines and tier-specific stitching, embossing and branding are deferred; the structural bottom is solid.
Technical colors are neutral. Tier finishes are parameter placeholders, not final photorealistic materials.
